title: Teach a model to write text like my documents
blurb: Give it a pile of writing and it learns to continue it. Good for a house style, a character voice, or a domain's jargon.

fields.name: steps
fields.label: How long to train
fields.help: More is usually better up to a point. Watch the held-out score.

fields.name: context
fields.label: How much it reads at once
fields.help: Characters of context. Longer costs memory and time.

fields.name: learning_rate
fields.label: Learning rate
fields.help: How big a step it takes. Too high and the loss goes to NaN.
